Leaflet v1.9.4
https://leafletjs.com/

https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/blob/main/LICENSE

Vendored (not CDN-loaded) to keep this app's own library code self-hosted,
per 01-ARCHITECTURE.md §0 ("always self-hosted"). Obtained via
`npm install leaflet` and copying dist/leaflet.js, dist/leaflet.css, and
dist/images/ verbatim — no build step, no modifications.

Note the one real exception this doesn't cover: Leaflet renders map TILES
it doesn't generate itself. Unless a tile server is also self-hosted
(e.g. TileServer GL, planned as future work — see 04-PHASEMAP.md Phase 2),
tile images are fetched from a public provider (OpenStreetMap's tile
servers by default) at runtime, in the end user's own browser. That's a
narrow, named exception to §0, not an oversight — recorded as a decision
per §17.3, same as any other exception to a non-negotiable would be.
